job.prompt:
Create one complete 30-second vertical 9:16 photorealistic editorial commercial for Vietnamese made-to-measure window mosquito-mesh brand Rem Vina. Use this exact product and room description: fine dark flexible woven insect mesh, flat neatly sewn black textile edging attached flush to a normal rectangular window, warm ivory plaster, oatmeal linen curtains, wooden sill, soft green garden outside. Maintain this same window, mesh construction, warm morning light and home throughout all shots.

0-6 seconds: immediate visual hook, close morning sunlight tracing the sheer curtain beside the mesh-covered window, then a smooth reveal of the complete rectangular window. Small natural curtain movement and changing leaf shadows, calm camera motion.
6-14 seconds: editorial cut to a beautiful close-up of the fine square mesh weave and tidy black sewn textile border against the window frame. Slow sideways macro camera slide, realistic thin flexible fabric, shallow depth of field; everything stays correctly attached and physically stable.
14-23 seconds: cut to a wider home composition with the same window and oatmeal drapes. Slow parallax camera move shows how discreetly the mesh fits into the room. The curtain gently lifts and settles while outdoor leaves sway softly. Keep the mesh flat and straight, no sagging or morphing geometry.
23-30 seconds: return to a balanced hero composition of the complete window, softly sunlit wall and curtains. A very gentle push-in gradually settles for the last three seconds. Allow calm visual space in the lower-middle area for later brand typography.

Premium but approachable Vietnamese home atmosphere, natural cream and oat palette, neutral charcoal mesh, restrained warm highlights, real fabric and subtle sunlight. Three intentional clean cuts only, consistent scene and color grade. No people, hands, insects, performance tests, tape measure, installation demonstration, roller screen, retractable mechanism, screws, added hardware, magical opening, distorted straight lines or extravagant luxury props. No text, captions, titles, numbers or logos in the generated scene; exact Vietnamese titles will be typeset afterward. Original soft room tone, light leaf rustle and very subtle original instrumental ambience if audio is supported; no speech, no recognizable song. Generate actual natural motion for all 30 seconds, not a still-image slideshow, not a loop, not a speed-stretched short clip. This is AI campaign illustration, not evidence of a real customer installation.
